label: Moment — The Occasion
description: The photograph taken because the day mattered. Crowded frames, mixed light and people reacting to each other rather than to the lens — a wedding, a birthday, a countdown.
prefix: A photograph of an occasion in full swing. {nationality}, {age}, {expression}, in the middle of it. {trigger}
suffix: Occasion Rendering: (people reacting to each other and not to the camera:1.25), (mixed light sources left unbalanced — warm practicals against cool ambient:1.2), (perfect hands, detailed fingers:1.2), motion allowed at the frame edges, (sharp focal subject in a busy frame:1.15).
negative: empty room, studio backdrop, single subject isolated, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, fused fingers, watermark, text, logo, child, chibi, underage
